headline: Brazil Central Bank Holds Selic Rate at 13.75%
summary: The Central Bank of Brazil's Copom committee maintained the Selic interest rate at 13.75%, ending a cycle of five consecutive cuts. The decision was largely anticipated by the market.
why: The Selic rate is the primary tool for controlling inflation in Brazil and serves as the benchmark for all local credit and investment products.
why_moved: Interest rate decisions are fundamental to asset pricing, affecting the cost of capital for companies and the yield attractiveness of fixed-income instruments.
